value.rationale: Closeness and harmonic centrality are canonical distance-based centrality measures with different aggregation principles. The smallest connected graph where they make different unambiguous choices of central actor is a natural structural boundary, and the shared competing distance profiles in the two first-conflict classes explain exactly why the split occurs.
